$Comment: The Horseman's Breastplate, one of the three pieces the Horseman's Hoard can pay (ZiggfreedCommon/Lootables/HallowsEvePack/Hallows_Eve_Horseman_Chase.json): the ancient steel he rides in, still warm. The game's ancient steel breastplate, field for field, with its recipe left out (it is never crafted), twice its durability (150), and one thing more: DamageBonus_Fire, Ziggfreed's CommonLib's stat for Fire damage the wearer deals, in whole percent points, so a Lantern Bomb or any fire weapon hits 5% harder with it on. Light is the ember glow it gives off. An Armor block written here replaces a parent's whole, so the file restates every leaf rather than naming a parent.
